in_sanskrit.name: अशिषाय
in_sanskrit.meaning: Not to be longed for, not to be desired
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अशिष् - Not to be, ईषा - Longing, आय - Desired. A name for a boy who is not longed for or desired, or for someone who does not desire anything.

in_hindi.name: अशिषाय
in_hindi.long_meaning: अशिषा - अपमाननीय (shameful, disgraceful), ईषा - ईषा (desire), आय - आय (towards). A name for a boy who is not desirable, or for someone who does not have a desire or is ashamed of something.

in_tamil.name: அசிஷய
in_tamil.long_meaning: அசிஷ் - அவர்கள் (They), ஷி - ஷ (Not), யாவன் - வான் (Man). A name for a boy who is not desired by others.

in_telugu.name: అశిషేయ
in_telugu.long_meaning: అశిష్ - అదేశ్ (not desirable), శేయ - శేశ్ (desirable), యదేశ్ (beloved). A name for a boy who is not desirable or for someone who is not beloved.

in_marathi.name: Ashishay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wish, Desire, Happiness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashishay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashishay is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ashisha’ and ‘ay’, which together mean ‘wish, desire, or happiness’. This name is a reflection of the deep longing and hope that is inherent in every human heart for joy, peace, and fulfillment.
